metadata.question: Was there more sediment in the Mekong River, specifically at location (20.248364, 100.141422), in January 27, 2015 compared to January 25, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Landsat 8 L2 SR for both dates with ±7 days, then ±16 days if empty. If still empty, try Landsat 7 L2 SR with the same windows. Location is a 120 m buffer around Point(100.141422, 20.248364).
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds, cloud shadow, cirrus, and dilated clouds using QA_PIXEL. Compute NDTI = (Red - Green)/(Red + Green) after scaling reflectance. Restrict to water using NDWI > 0.
3. Logic: 
   - If a date has no images after attempts: C1.
   - If images exist but valid NDTI pixels after masking are 0: C2.
   - If NDTI mean is null/NaN or outside [-1, 1]: C3.
   - Otherwise compare NDTI_2015 > NDTI_2020 => A, else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfo = (obj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

  function applyScaleFactorsL2SR(img) {
    // Apply scale/offset to optical SR bands
    const optical = img.select('SR_B.*').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(optical, null, true);
  }

  function maskLandsatL2Clouds(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // Dilated Cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))      // Cirrus
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))      // Cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0));     // Cloud Shadow
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }

  function makeNdtiImage(img) {
    // Expect L7 or L8 L2 SR bands
    const B = (nameIfL8, nameIfL7) => ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(
      img.bandNames().contains(nameIfL8), nameIfL8, nameIfL7
    ));
    const greenName = B('SR_B3', 'SR_B2');
    const redName   = B('SR_B4', 'SR_B3');
    const nirName   = B('SR_B5', 'SR_B4');

    const green = img.select(greenName);
    const red   = img.select(redName);
    const nir   = img.select(nirName);

    const ndti = red.subtract(green).divide(red.add(green)).rename('NDTI');
    const ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI');
    const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0);
    return ndti.updateMask(waterMask);
  }

  function cloudFraction(img, geom, scale) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloudBits = (1 << 1) | (1 << 2) | (1 << 3) | (1 << 4);
    const clouds = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBits).neq(0).rename('clouds');
    const cloudCount = clouds.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('clouds');
    const totalCount = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('one');
    const frac = ee.Number(cloudCount).divide(totalCount).multiply(100);
    return { frac, cloudCount, totalCount };
  }

  async function findBestImageForDate(targetDate, geom) {
    const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2');
    const l7 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2');
    const windows = [7, 16];

    let sizeReport = { l8w1: 0, l8w2: 0, l7w1: 0, l7w2: 0 };
    let chosen = null;
    let chosenSensor = null;
    let chosenWin = null;

    for (let wi = 0; wi < windows.length && !chosen; wi++) {
      const w = windows[wi];
      const start = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-w, 'day');
      const end = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(w + 1, 'day');

      const colL8 = l8.filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
      const colL7 = l7.filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);

      const sL8 = await getInfo(colL8.size());
      const sL7 = await getInfo(colL7.size());
      if (wi === 0) {
        sizeReport.l8w1 = sL8;
        sizeReport.l7w1 = sL7;
      } else {
        sizeReport.l8w2 = sL8;
        sizeReport.l7w2 = sL7;
      }

      const pickBest = (col) =>
        col.map(img => img.set('diffDays', img.date().difference(targetDate, 'day').abs()))
           .sort('diffDays')
           .first();

      if (sL8 > 0 && !chosen) {
        chosen = pickBest(colL8);
        chosenSensor = 'L8';
        chosenWin = w;
      } else if (sL7 > 0 && !chosen) {
        chosen = pickBest(colL7);
        chosenSensor = 'L7';
        chosenWin = w;
      }
    }
    return { image: chosen, sensor: chosenSensor, win: chosenWin, sizes: sizeReport };
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const point = ee.Geometry.Point([100.141422, 20.248364]);
  const region = point.buffer(120);
  const reduceScale = 1000; // per instruction
  const date2015 = ee.Date('2015-01-27');
  const date2020 = ee.Date('2020-01-25');

  try {
    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const found2015 = await findBestImageForDate(date2015, region);
    const found2020 = await findBestImageForDate(date2020, region);

    console.log(`2015 imgs L8: ${found2015.sizes.l8w1} (±7d), ${found2015.sizes.l8w2} (±16d); L7: ${found2015.sizes.l7w1}, ${found2015.sizes.l7w2}`);
    console.log(`2020 imgs L8: ${found2020.sizes.l8w1} (±7d), ${found2020.sizes.l8w2} (±16d); L7: ${found2020.sizes.l7w1}, ${found2020.sizes.l7w2}`);

    if (!found2015.image || !found2020.image) {
      console.log("C1");
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    function prepNdti(img) {
      const scaled = applyScaleFactorsL2SR(img);
      const masked = maskLandsatL2Clouds(scaled);
      return makeNdtiImage(masked);
    }

    const img2015 = ee.Image(found2015.image);
    const img2020 = ee.Image(found2020.image);

    const ndti2015 = prepNdti(img2015);
    const ndti2020 = prepNdti(img2020);

    const dateStr2015 = await getInfo(img2015.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    const dateStr2020 = await getInfo(img2020.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'));

    const count2015 = await getInfo(ndti2015.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region, scale: reduceScale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NDTI'));
    const count2020 = await getInfo(ndti2020.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region, scale: reduceScale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NDTI'));

    if (!count2015 || count2015 === 0 || !count2020 || count2020 === 0) {
      console.log(`ValidPix 2015: ${count2015 || 0}, 2020: ${count2020 || 0}`);
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }

    const mean2015 = await getInfo(ndti2015.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: region, scale: reduceScale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NDTI'));
    const mean2020 = await getInfo(ndti2020.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: region, scale: reduceScale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NDTI'));

    // Cloud fractions for context
    const cf2015 = cloudFraction(img2015, region, reduceScale);
    const cf2020 = cloudFraction(img2020, region, reduceScale);
    const cloudPct2015 = await getInfo(cf2015.frac);
    const cloudPct2020 = await getInfo(cf2020.frac);

    // 4. Validation
    const invalid2015 = (mean2015 === null) || isNaN(mean2015) || mean2015 < -1 || mean2015 > 1;
    const invalid2020 = (mean2020 === null) || isNaN(mean2020) || mean2020 < -1 || mean2020 > 1;

    console.log(`2015 sel: ${dateStr2015} (${found2015.sensor}), Cloud%: ${cloudPct2015?.toFixed ? cloudPct2015.toFixed(1) : cloudPct2015}, ValidPix: ${count2015}, NDTI: ${mean2015}`);
    console.log(`2020 sel: ${dateStr2020} (${found2020.sensor}), Cloud%: ${cloudPct2020?.toFixed ? cloudPct2020.toFixed(1) : cloudPct2020}, ValidPix: ${count2020}, NDTI: ${mean2020}`);

    if (invalid2015 || invalid2020) {
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }

    // 5. Final Answer: higher NDTI => more sediment
    const answer = (mean2015 > mean2020) ? "A" : "B";
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log("D");
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
